_note: Τέλος ταξινόμησης. The cylinder-capacity tables of the 2001 law are dead for passenger cars: article 59 of law 4389/2016 replaced them with a scale on the taxable value, adjusted by CO2 and by how current the car's emission standard is. AADE's own applied grid reproduces the same numbers — 3.80 / 4.00 / 4.40 … 8.00% for the cheapest bracket across the eight CO2 bands — which is the product of the base rate and the CO2 multiplier below. The taxable value is the pre-tax retail price of the equivalent new car less an age reduction, so the price paid stands in for it and the line says so in red. The emission tier is read from the year of first registration, taking the later side of each boundary.

source.title: Ν. 4389/2016 άρθρο 59, τροποποίηση άρθρου 121 Ν. 2960/2001 (ΦΕΚ Α΄94/27.5.2016)
